svg.text: Byte order: message bytes in, digest bits out
Message byte stream, in natural order
byte j lands at bits 8j+7 downto 8j
the shift puts b0 at the bottom, bits 7:0
lane k = state (x, y) with k = x + 5y, 17 rate lanes of 1088 bits
digest[7:0] is hash byte 0, ie the leftmost byte of the conventional hex string, so
